Cho phép lưu và hiển thị hồ sơ, nhiệt độ: Allow BabyCare to store and display the profile, temperature, vaccinations, feeding, sleep, and data you choose to enter.

Bạn có thể xem, sửa hoặc xóa hồ sơ bé và: You can view, edit, or delete baby profiles and account data in Settings. Withdrawing consent may stop features that require that data.
BabyCare là công cụ ghi nhận và sắp xếp: BabyCare records and organizes care information provided by users. It does not examine, diagnose, prescribe, calculate doses, or replace doctors and healthcare professionals.
Bạn chịu trách nhiệm bảo vệ tài khoản, c: You are responsible for protecting your account, providing information that is accurate to the best of your knowledge, and creating a child profile only when you are a parent, guardian, or otherwise legally authorized.
Không dùng BabyCare cho tình huống cấp c: Do not use BabyCare in an emergency or as the sole basis for treatment decisions. If a child shows serious symptoms, contact an appropriate healthcare facility or emergency service.
Bạn có thể xóa riêng hồ sơ bé hoặc xóa t: You can delete an individual baby profile or your account in Settings. Deletion requires explicit confirmation because deleted data cannot be restored in the app.

Chế độ cloud sử dụng Supabase để xác thự: Cloud mode uses Supabase for authentication, data and photos. A family owner can invite others with a single-use code, as a caregiver (view and log) or a viewer. Every member sees every baby profile in the family and each other's email; the owner can change roles or remove members, and members can leave. Reports are sent through the sharing option you choose. Voice entry uses Apple Speech; when on-device recognition is unavailable, audio may be processed through Apple's service. Weather comes from Apple Weather (WeatherKit) using your approximate location. Only the developer sees feedback and its screenshots. A feature suggestion is shown to other users only after the developer approves it, with its title, description and vote count but nothing about who sent it; who voted is not shown either.
Dữ liệu được giữ khi hồ sơ hoặc tài khoả: Data is kept while a profile or account remains active. Only a family owner can delete a baby profile, and the deletion applies to every member. Deleting your account removes the families only you use, your cloud data, photos and this account's cache on this device. A family that has other members is not deleted: its longest-standing member becomes the owner and keeps the family's data, including what you logged. Feedback, screenshots, suggestions, votes and reports are kept no longer than your account: deleting your account deletes them too, and suggestions you sent stop appearing for others.
Bạn kiểm soát dữ liệu mình nhập và nội d: You control the data you enter and choose what appears in reports. Check the recipient before sharing a PDF or link containing a child's information. Only invite people you trust into your family, because they will see every baby profile in it.

BabyCare has no tolerance for objectionable content or abusive users: every suggestion is reviewed before others can see it, reported content is reviewed within 24 hours and removed if it breaks these rules, and accounts that break them may be suspended. The developer may use feedback and suggestions to improve the app but has no obligation to build them or pay for them.
